description:
Build a view that toggles between two text values using <state>.

State: a single <state name="label" value="'on'" />.

Layout:
  - A <span data-test="label"> showing the current value of label.
  - A <ship-button data-test="set-on"> labelled "on" that sets label to 'on'.
  - A <ship-button data-test="set-off"> labelled "off" that sets label to 'off'.
